title: 智能体应如何交流？面向高效多智能体系统的行动-状态通信
summary: 分析了多智能体系统中五种常见通信策略，发现无固定策略普遍最优。提出PACT（协议化行动-状态通信与传输），将智能体间通信视为公共状态更新问题，将原始输出压缩为紧凑的行动-状态记录，从而在保持或提升任务性能的同时显著减少token消耗。在OpenHands和SWE-agent等生产环境中验证了有效性。
summary_en: Analyzes five common inter-agent communication strategies, finding no universally optimal fixed strategy. Proposes PACT, which treats inter-agent communication as a public state-update problem and compresses raw outputs into compact action-state records, achieving comparable or better performance with substantially fewer tokens. Validated on production systems like OpenHands and SWE-agent.
